common_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production square ability icon for the dark fantasy roguelite Abyssal Echoes: Void Weaver. Create ONE finished square illustration, no sheet, no typography. Cohesive premium hand-painted fantasy game icon style: bold iconic silhouette, controlled painterly brushwork, crisp readable focal object, bevelled steel and luminous magical effects, dramatic rim lighting, subtle textured near-black midnight-navy vignette background. Focal subject occupies 75% of canvas with generous 10% safe margin. Clear at 32 pixels yet beautiful at 256 pixels. No words, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, UI, card frame, border, photorealism, cartoon face, excessive detail or scenery.

assets.name: Slash
assets.subject: A single sharp silver longsword sweeping diagonally upward, one broad curved crimson-red slash trail, sparks from the cutting edge. Basic physical strike, elegant uncluttered composition.

assets.name: Slash II
assets.subject: Two bright interlocking crimson crescent slash trails around a sharp silver longsword, stronger red energy and a few golden impact sparks. Advanced physical slash.

assets.name: Rift Sunder
assets.subject: An obsidian-and-silver longsword cutting a jagged glowing scar through reality, brilliant white cutting edge, crimson arc and violet rift splitting behind it. Legendary master sword attack.

assets.name: Power Strike
assets.subject: A heavy steel warhammer head crashing downward onto a small fractured stone surface, compact amber impact burst and a few stone shards. Powerful single blow, massive readable hammer silhouette.

assets.name: Power Strike II
assets.subject: A heavy angular steel warhammer striking with two concentric amber shockwave arcs, bright golden cracks spreading through black stone, several large stone fragments. Advanced crushing blow.

assets.name: World Crusher
assets.subject: An immense dark metal warhammer with a molten golden core smashing a fractured floating stone sphere, vivid amber shockwave and major black stone shards. Master armor-shattering impact.

assets.name: Whirlwind
assets.subject: A broad silver sword blade spiralling around a clearly defined circular steel-white wind vortex, restrained crimson cutting edge accents. One readable circular spinning attack silhouette.

assets.name: Whirlwind II
assets.subject: Two crescent silver sword blades circling a strong steel-white wind spiral with brighter crimson ribbon trails, sharp clean rotation silhouette, advanced sweeping attack.

assets.name: Vortex of Souls
assets.subject: Three ghostly silver blades spiralling around a hollow teal spectral vortex, wisps of restless spirit energy, fine crimson cutting accents, powerful master spinning attack.

assets.name: Snipe
assets.subject: One long silver arrow with dark fletching flying diagonally through a thin luminous amber targeting ring, bright sharp arrowhead, minimal golden motion trail. Precision archer shot.

assets.name: Snipe II
assets.subject: One ornate steel arrow with a broad piercing arrowhead flying through two concentric amber targeting rings, brighter golden trail and sparks. Advanced precision archer shot.

assets.name: Shadow Hunt
assets.subject: A black obsidian arrow with brilliant silver tip guided by a spectral violet raven-wing shaped wake and a thin cold teal tracking arc. Master void-guided arrow, no actual bird.

assets.name: Fireball
assets.subject: A single blazing orange-red fireball with a bright molten yellow core and a curved flame tail, travelling diagonally upward, tiny embers. Strong simple unmistakable fire spell silhouette.

assets.name: Fireball II
assets.subject: A large intense orange-red fireball with white-hot golden core and a double curling flame tail, two smaller surrounding sparks, clearly more powerful than a basic fireball.

assets.name: Hellfire Torrent
assets.subject: A jagged demonic red-violet rift pouring three distinct streams of white-hot orange hellfire downward, flame droplets and cinders. Master infernal rain spell, compact powerful composition.

assets.name: Magic Bolt
assets.subject: A sharp elongated violet magical energy bolt, electric cyan spear-shaped core, short violet lightning branches and directional particle trail. One focused arcane projectile, not a book.

assets.name: Magic Bolt II
assets.subject: An intense elongated violet energy lance with twin cyan lightning filaments spiralling tightly around its brilliant core, strong directional trail. Advanced single-target arcane projectile.

assets.name: Arcane Overload
assets.subject: A huge concentrated cyan-white energy spear erupting through a shattered violet arcane halo, branching violet lightning wrapped around the projectile, brilliant controlled focal point. Master magic bolt.

assets.name: Arcane Blast
assets.subject: A compact violet arcane orb bursting outward into a circular cyan-violet shockwave, bright central star, four broad magical rays, unmistakable radial magical explosion.

assets.name: Arcane Blast II
assets.subject: An intense violet orb exploding into two layered cyan-violet shockwave rings, white starburst core and floating obsidian shards, advanced radial arcane explosion.

assets.name: Void Singularity
assets.subject: A perfectly black circular void core with an intense violet and cyan accretion ring, curved luminous trails and several stone shards being pulled inward. Master gravitational singularity, simple powerful circular silhouette.

assets.name: Smite
assets.subject: A single brilliant ivory-gold lightning column striking a small dark cracked sigil stone, sharp angular lightning silhouette and compact golden impact. Divine magical punishment.

assets.name: Smite II
assets.subject: Two ivory-gold lightning forks converging into one heavy radiant strike on a dark stone, circular pale gold radiance around the impact, advanced divine punishment.

assets.name: Dread Retribution
assets.subject: A corrupted ivory-gold lightning spear wrapped in deep violet shadow striking through a fractured spectral soul silhouette, gold-violet halo behind. Master corrupted divine judgment, no gore.

assets.name: Heal
assets.subject: Two softly cupped armored hands cradling one luminous emerald-green life flame, warm ivory core, restrained green healing motes. Gentle restoration spell, clean centered silhouette.

assets.name: Heal II
assets.subject: Two cupped silver armored hands cradling a larger emerald-green life flame with two curling luminous leaf-shaped wisps, brighter ivory core and green healing motes. Advanced restoration spell.

assets.name: Abyssal Rejuvenation
assets.subject: A radiant emerald and teal tree-of-life sprout rising from two cupped dark silver hands, ivory heart-shaped light at its roots, sweeping luminous green branches, shadow-violet outer aura. Master healing spell.

assets.name: Rally
assets.subject: A single weathered crimson battlefield pennant on a dark steel spear, warm amber-gold glow rising around it as a sign of renewed courage, one green recovery spark. Compact banner silhouette.

assets.name: Rally II
assets.subject: A proud crimson battlefield banner with a steel spear tip surrounded by two curved amber-gold waves of inspiring energy, several emerald recovery sparks, advanced rally ability. No emblem letters.

assets.name: Dominator's Decree
assets.subject: A dark steel crown suspended above a crimson command banner, three sweeping golden rays extending downward to three emerald life lights, powerful regal master party-wide restorative command.

assets.name: Abyssal Chains
assets.subject: Three heavy black iron chain segments with glowing violet links wrapping tightly around a spectral cyan soul flame, sharp outward purple arcs implying a stunning bind. Boss void-chain control spell.

assets.name: Void Shackle
assets.subject: A single large broken-open dark iron wrist shackle snapping closed around a brilliant violet orb, two short black chain tails and cold cyan magical sparks. Distinct from multiple binding chains.

assets.name: Soul Rend
assets.subject: Two curved dark silver claws tearing across a translucent teal soul-shaped flame, three bright crimson diagonal spectral wounds with drifting red wisps, no body or gore. Boss soul-tearing bleed attack.

assets.name: Soul Execute
assets.subject: A large dark silver execution blade descending through a fragile violet spectral soul flame, brilliant crimson cutting edge and sharp white final-impact flare. Decisive finisher silhouette, no body or gore.

assets.name: Ruinous Slam
assets.subject: An enormous armored stone-and-obsidian monster fist smashing into black ground, vivid amber radial cracks, a broad dusty shockwave ring and a few large rock shards. Boss earth-shattering slam, no full monster.
